primitives.name: Style Descriptor Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## STYLE descriptor Write the render style, palette, line character, and finish once.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'render style descriptor (dimensionless)', 'P': 'palette specification (dimensionless)', 'L': 'line character descriptor (dimensionless)', 'F': 'finish quality indicator (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: All visual clips share identical S, P, L, F across the sequence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S, P, L, F vary between clips, narrative coherence fails.

layer2.mapping: GSI latent variable model maps S,P,L,F to visual fidelity metrics; GSE state transition uses these for style-consistent rendering.
layer2.telemetry: Style match score between reference and generated frames.

primitives.name: Narration Block Structure
primitives.verbatim_quote: Narrate per block so each voice take maps to exactly one 10-second clip.
primitives.assumptions: Each B_n corresponds to a unique V and T=10s.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure when voice-to-block ratio deviates from 1:1.

layer2.mapping: GSI temporal segmentation aligns V with B_n; GSE tracks B_n progression through time.
layer2.telemetry: Temporal alignment error between narration and visual block.

primitives.name: Motion Grammar Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: MOTION: {camera move and animation behavior—slow push-in, drift, scale shock, hard contrast cut}.
primitives.assumptions: Each block has one M, C, A tuple uniquely defined.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Motion ambiguity arises when multiple behaviors are assigned to one block.

layer2.mapping: GSI encodes M,C,A into motion parameters; GSE applies them as state transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Motion parameter deviation from expected behavior.
